Ravi Menon: Dropping a new microcopy pass for the rollout timeline. Trying to keep CTAs explicit and avoid modal overload. Mock: https://redwood.design/mocks/versions/microcopy-v1 Priya Shah: Nice. One high-level: prefer verbs with destination: 'Promote to stable' rather than 'Promote'. Also avoid 'Rollback' alone 12 consider 'Rollback to previous stable' for clarity. Clara: Accessibility note: any inline confirm should not rely solely on visual color. Add clear labels and a focusable confirm control. Marta: UX nit: for canary pause inline confirm, don't use a full modal. Use an inline row with two buttons: 'Pause canary' and 'Cancel'. Keep it consistent with the quick action row pattern. Ravi Menon: Proposed inline pattern: ```html

Pause canary 0% 022-07-01 14:03

Pausing will route traffic to fallback immediately. Press Enter to confirm.
``` Priya Shah: Good. For screen reader: announce the effect immediately when confirmed: role="status" aria-live="polite" with message 'Canary paused. Traffic routing to stable.' QA - Jorge: From testing: keyboard users sometimes trigger the secondary action accidentally because focus order flows left-to-right. Ensure logical DOM order: Cancel then Pause, or use a confirmation pattern that requires an extra keystroke for destructive ops. Marta: I prefer Cancel then Pause to give a safe default focus. Visual emphasis can still highlight Pause as primary. Ravi Menon: Copy tweak for auto-hold toast: change from 'Auto-hold triggered' to 'Canary auto-hold: increased error rate detected.' More explicit and searchable in logs. deploy-bot: Canary run logged: 1946200001-canary-autohold (10% -> 50% -> auto-hold). Clara: For rollbacks initiated from the timeline, we debated typed confirmations vs reason selectors. My recommendation: default to required reason selector (dropdown) + optional notes. Provide org-level setting to require typed confirmation for safety-critical accounts. Priya Shah: Implementation note: add aria-describedby linking the selected reason to the rollback confirmation button so SR users get the context: 'Confirm rollback. Reason: performance regression.' QA - Jorge: I'll validate these flows: 1) inline pause confirm keyboard order 2) aria-live announcements on confirm 3) rollback reason selector is read back to the user before final confirm. Will post failures by EOD. Ravi Menon: One last microcopy: action tooltip for 'Promote to stable' -> 'Promote this version to receive 100% traffic' (avoid ambiguous 'promote'). Priya Shah: Thanks everyone. I'll update the mock and the component spec with the aria examples and copy changes. Will ping when uploaded. :rocket:
